data.name: SkyChart: Airline Executive
data.detailed_description:
THE GOLDEN AGE OF AIRLINES IS YOURS TO BUILD

You are the CEO. Starting with a handful of biplanes and a dream, build a globe-spanning airline from 1930 to 2020. Open routes, buy and lease aircraft, configure cabin classes, invest in airports, hire executives, and crush your rivals — all while history unfolds around you.

SkyChart: Airline Executive is a deep management simulation inspired by the classic Aerobiz series, rebuilt from the ground up with modern design, a retro-neon aesthetic, and systems deep enough to lose a weekend in.

AT A GLANCE

  • 4 historical eras from 1930 to 2095 — each unlocks by mastering the previous

  • 528 real-world cities across 8 regions with population-driven demand

  • 196 historical aircraft from DC-3 to A380 with realistic stats and retirement curves

  • 4 cabin classes (Economy, Premium Economy, Business, First) with per-class demand and era-gated unlocks

  • Up to 35 AI rival airlines with 4 distinct strategy archetypes (Budget, Regional, Legacy, Premium)

  • 190+ historical events — Great Depression, WWII, deregulation, 1973 oil crisis, 9/11, COVID-19

  • Live weather system with storm cells, pressure fronts, jet streams, and route re-planning

  • 100 achievements spanning operations, finance, history, and diplomacy

  • 17-chapter interactive tutorial hosted by Casey the Macaw, chief flight inspector

  • 29 languages (store-page translations rolling out EA → 1.0)

  • Full Steam Deck support with Steam Input API and automatic glyph detection

FIVE ERAS OF AVIATION

Play through four distinct chapters of airline history, each with unique aircraft, economics, and challenges:

  • Dawn of Flight (1930–1950) - Biplanes, flying boats, and the shadow of World War II. Connect the continents before the world tears itself apart.

  • The Jet Age (1955–1975) - The 707 rewrites everything. Dominate the transatlantic corridor and race your rivals across the globe.

  • The Modern Era (1980–2000) - Deregulation, oil crises, and cutthroat competition. Only the efficient survive.

  • Supersonic Future (2000–2020) - Ultra-long-haul routes, mega-hubs, and the A380 age. Build an empire that spans every continent - then survive COVID.

  • The Green Frontier (2020-2040) - Post-pandemic recovery, sustainable aviation mandates, hydrogen demonstrators, and electric regional commuters. Build a fleet for a carbon-conscious world. 

Each era must be conquered before the next unlocks. Prove you can survive the prop age before you earn the jets.

528 REAL-WORLD CITIES

From New York to Nairobi, Tokyo to Timbuktu - 528 cities across 8 world regions with real airport locations, population-driven demand, tourist appeal, and regional diplomacy that guide your expansion. Invest in hotels, theme parks, and infrastructure to boost demand. Upgrade airport hubs to dominate entire regions.

196 HISTORICAL AIRCRAFT

Fly the planes that made history. The DC-3, 707, 747, A380, 787, and more — each with historically accurate stats, retirement dates, and operating costs. Aircraft age realistically: old planes cost more to run, draw fewer passengers, and depreciate on a real curve. Order new-build aircraft on a realistic 1-9 month delivery backlog, lease for instant service, or store surplus frames in your hangar.

CABIN CLASS CONFIGURATION

Configure every route's seat mix: Economy, Premium Economy, Business, or First. Higher classes occupy more cabin space but earn 1.6×-4× the fare. Class availability is era-gated — First Class reappears in 1955, Business in 1960, Premium Economy in 1992 — so strategy shifts as decades pass. Six one-click templates (All Economy, Budget, Regional, Legacy, Premium, Luxury) or hand-tune per route with the stepper UI. AI rivals pick strategies too and stick to them.

LIVE WEATHER SYSTEM

A Ventusky-style weather map with animated storm cells (tropical round-with-eye, extratropical comma-heads), jet streams, pressure isobars, and cloud shading. Storms drift on prevailing winds — westerlies mid-latitude, trade easterlies in the tropics — and seed from real IBTrACS cyclone data. Route paths dynamically deviate around severe weather at FAA-style distances, and your airplanes' animated tracks update every 8 seconds as storms move.

BUY, LEASE, OR SCRAP

Every aircraft decision matters. Buy planes outright and build equity, or lease them to preserve cash with flexible 1-year, 3-year, or 5-year terms. Store surplus aircraft in your hangar for reuse. Refurbish aging fleets to extend their service life. Sell at depreciated market value when it's time to move on. Your rivals make these same calculations.

OUTSMART YOUR RIVALS

Up to 35 AI-controlled airlines compete for the same routes, slots, and passengers. Each picks one of four cabin strategies — Budget (all-economy), Regional (light premium), Legacy (full four-class), or Premium (first-heavy) — and sticks to it, so the competitive landscape feels distinct. They price dynamically, expand into your territory, upgrade their fleets, and invest in hubs. Once per era, you can buy out a rival entirely — absorbing their routes, slots, and infrastructure in one stroke.

HISTORY HAPPENS

190+ historical events and World Mega-Events reshape the playing field. The Great Depression tanks demand. WWII closes entire regions. The 1973 oil crisis doubles fuel prices overnight. 9/11 grounds the industry. COVID-19 kills 93% of passenger demand (but cargo barely flinches). Earthquakes destroy airports. Volcanic ash clouds close European airspace. You adapt or you fold.

DEEP ECONOMICS

Every route's profit is calculated monthly from population, regional economics, seasonal demand, your reputation, competitor pricing, hub bonuses, diplomatic relations, fuel costs, aircraft condition, cabin mix, transfer passenger flows, and executive team bonuses. The Strategic Advisor scans all 122,760 possible city pairs (threaded, non-blocking) to find your best opportunities. Quarterly reports track every dollar.

THREE GAME MODES

  • Passengers — Fill seats. Maximize yield per passenger. The classic airline business.

  • Cargo — Move freight. Win on price and reliability. Cargo barely flinches during pandemics.

  • Combined — Passengers in the cabin, freight in the belly. Two revenue streams, one fleet.

Each mode unlocks after mastering the previous one.

FIVE DIFFICULTY LEVELS

From Glider (generous capital, slow rivals) to Supersonic (lean budget, aggressive AI, punishing interest rates). Five finely tuned tiers so new players can learn the ropes and veterans can suffer.

SANDBOX MODE

Completed your first era? Unlock Sandbox. No bankruptcy. No era limits. No time pressure. Pick a starting decade and build forever.

YOUR COCKPIT

  • Strategic Advisor — AI-powered route recommendations, hub analysis, worst-route alerts

  • Route Manager — Sort, filter, suspend, sell, or upgrade any route. Handles 2,000+ routes smoothly

  • Fleet Overview — Active fleet, hangar inventory, and lease management in one panel

  • City Intelligence — Per-city demand, slot availability, investment ROI, competitor presence

  • Competitive Intel — Track rival expansion and retreat across every region

  • Quarterly Reports — Revenue, costs, market share, and 8-quarter trend charts

  • Diplomacy Panel — Improve regional relations through donations and executive hires

  • Strategy Planner — Queue up your next moves with budget tracking and one-click execution

  • Cabin Configuration Panel — Per-route seat mix with era-gated class unlocks and live revenue delta vs all-economy

  • Weather Map Overlay — Storm cells, jet streams, pressure isobars, and cloud layers

  • 100 Achievements — Milestones across operations, finance, technology, history, cabin strategy, and diplomacy

A MAP WORTH STARING AT

A Mercator projection world map with great-circle flight paths, animated aircraft, weather radar, a day/night terminator, and demand heatmaps. Three visual styles: Retro Dark (neon-on-black default), Satellite (real-world imagery), and Clean Vector. Zoom into any region for OpenStreetMap-style high-detail tiles. Routes auto-fade as your network grows, so even 1,200+ routes stay readable.

ERA SOUNDTRACK

44 tracks spanning the 1930s through the 2020s shift dynamically as you advance through the decades. Crossfading transitions, achievement fanfares, and a built-in music player with support for local files and Spotify integration.

LEARN FROM CASEY THE MACAW

Your chief flight inspector is a macaw with strong opinions. Casey narrates a 17-chapter, 134-step interactive tutorial covering everything from opening your first route to configuring cabin classes, managing weather diversions, and running a legacy carrier. Every in-game changelog entry is written in Casey's voice — he inspects rivets, files paperwork, and takes credit for every bug fix.

PLAY YOUR WAY

  • Full keyboard & mouse with hotkeys for every panel

  • Full controller support — Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, Steam Deck with automatic glyph detection

  • Radial menu — Hold LB + right stick to instantly open any panel

  • Virtual cursor — Right stick for city selection on the world map

  • Draggable windows — Every panel is movable, resizable, and remembers its position

  • Graphical Controls Guide — Keycap and button widgets for every input method

  • Scales to any resolution from 1280x720 and up



FULL FEATURE LIST

  • 4 historical eras (1930–2020) with progression unlocks

  • 528 real-world cities across 8 regions

  • 196 historically accurate aircraft with delivery backlog (1-9 months)

  • 4 cabin classes with era-gated unlocks and per-route configuration

  • 6 cabin templates + hand-tuned stepper UI

  • 3 game modes (Passengers, Cargo, Combined)

  • 5 difficulty levels

  • Sandbox mode with no limits

  • 190+ historical events and World Mega-Events

  • Up to 35 AI rival airlines with 4 distinct cabin strategy archetypes

  • Rival acquisition system (1 buyout per era)

  • Aircraft leasing, hangars, refurbishment, and depreciation

  • Airport slots, hubs, and ground investments

  • Transfer / connecting passenger flows

  • Diplomacy and regional relations

  • Executive hiring with passive bonuses

  • Maintenance, safety, and reputation management

  • PR campaigns and customer service tiers

  • Live weather system with storm cells, jet streams, pressure isobars

  • Dynamic route re-planning around severe weather

  • Strategic Advisor scanning 139,128 city pairs (threaded, non-blocking)

  • Route performance analytics and quarterly reports

  • 100 achievements

  • 17-chapter interactive tutorial with Casey the Macaw

  • Full save system (5 slots + autosave)

  • Steam Cloud save sync with self-healing progression unlocks

  • Era-aware dynamic soundtrack (44 tracks)

  • Built-in music player with Spotify integration

  • Full keyboard, mouse, and controller support

  • Steam Input API with automatic glyph detection

  • Steam Deck verified-ready

  • Runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux

data.short_description: Inspired by Aerobiz. Build a global airline empire across 90 years of aviation history. Open routes between 528 real-world cities, buy or lease 196 historical aircraft, outmaneuver 35 rival CEOs, and survive the Great Depression, oil shocks, 9/11, and COVID.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (dual-core 2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible (Intel HD 4000 / GT 710)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Network is optional for HD Map Tiles
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD RX 560 / Intel Iris Xe
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Network is optional for HD Map Tiles

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable (all M-series; Intel HD 4000+
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Network is optional for HD Map Tiles
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Network is optional for HD Map Tiles

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
